mode: actual assessment prices; approximate city station coordinates

fuel.accounting: Initial fuel consumed first; trip cost values consumed initial fuel plus purchases. Unconsumed initial inventory is excluded. Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP at output; rounded line items may differ from total by cents.
